Graduate / Junior Full Stack Developer (AI & Agile)-
Newly Created Position – Make Your Mark!

Dynamic & Growing Software Specialist

🚀 AI-Driven Development Environment

🔄 Agile Team Culture

Hybrid or Work from Home

🌟 Excellent Career Growth & Mentoring Opportunities

About Expedient Software
For over 30 years, Expedient Software has been delivering specialist software solutions to the Customs, Freight Forwarding, Logistics, and Accounting industries. Our clients range from global multinational organisations to growing SMEs that rely on our innovative SaaS platforms to run their businesses.

As we continue to grow and embrace AI-powered development practices, we have created an exciting opportunity for a Graduate or Junior Full Stack Developer to join our team and make a real impact from day one.

This is not a role where you'll be confined to a single technology or development task. You'll gain exposure across the entire software development lifecycle, work with modern technologies, leverage AI development tools, and be mentored by experienced professionals in a collaborative Agile environment.

About the Role
As a Graduate/Junior Full Stack Developer, you will work as part of an Agile development team building, enhancing, and supporting innovative SaaS applications. You'll have the opportunity to contribute across both front-end and back-end development while learning best practices in software engineering, cloud technologies, AI-assisted development, and solution design.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about technology, eager to learn, and excited about using AI tools to improve productivity, code quality, and innovation.

Key Responsibilities
Participate in the design, development, testing, and deployment of software solutions

Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders in an Agile environment

Utilise modern AI development tools to enhance coding efficiency and problem solving

Develop and maintain front-end and back-end application components

Work with relational databases, data modelling, and SQL queries

Assist with troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimisation

Contribute to code reviews, sprint planning, and continuous improvement initiatives

Learn and apply best practices throughout the software development lifecycle

About You
We're looking for someone who has a genuine passion for software development and technology. You are curious, motivated, and eager to continuously learn and improve.

Essential Skills & Experience
Recently completed or nearing completion of a relevant degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or similar)

Exposure to software development in any programming language

Understanding of relational database concepts

Knowledge of data modelling and SQL

Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar

Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving abilities

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Understanding of Agile methodologies and collaborative development practices

Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team

Desirable
Exposure to web application development

Knowledge of cloud technologies or SaaS platforms

Experience with version control systems such as Git

Personal development projects, internships, or contributions to open-source projects

What We Offer
A genuine opportunity to launch your software development career

Mentoring from experienced software professionals

Exposure to the latest AI-powered development practices

A supportive and collaborative Agile culture

Career progression and ongoing professional development

The opportunity to work across the full software development lifecycle

A stable, growing Australian software company with a strong industry reputation

Ready to Apply?
If you're a bright and motivated developer looking for a unique opportunity to build your career, work with modern AI technologies, and make a meaningful contribution in a growing software company, we'd love to hear from you.

Our clients range from global multinational organisations to growing SMEs that rely on our innovative SaaS platforms to run their businesses.

As we continue to grow and embrace AI-powered development practices, we have created an exciting opportunity for a Graduate or Junior Full Stack Developer to join our team and make a real impact from day one.

This is not a role where you'll be confined to a single technology or development task. You'll gain exposure across the entire software development lifecycle, work with modern technologies, leverage AI development tools, and be mentored by experienced professionals in a collaborative Agile environment.

About the Role
As a Graduate/Junior Full Stack Developer, you will work as part of an Agile development team building, enhancing, and supporting innovative SaaS applications. You'll have the opportunity to contribute across both front-end and back-end development while learning best practices in software engineering, cloud technologies, AI-assisted development, and solution design.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about technology, eager to learn, and excited about using AI tools to improve productivity, code quality, and innovation.

Key Responsibilities
Participate in the design, development, testing, and deployment of software solutions

Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders in an Agile environment

Utilise modern AI development tools to enhance coding efficiency and problem solving

Develop and maintain front-end and back-end application components

Work with relational databases, data modelling, and SQL queries

Assist with troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimisation

Contribute to code reviews, sprint planning, and continuous improvement initiatives

Learn and apply best practices throughout the software development lifecycle

About You
We're looking for someone who has a genuine passion for software development and technology. You are curious, motivated, and eager to continuously learn and improve.

Essential Skills & Experience
Recently completed or nearing completion of a relevant degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or similar)

Exposure to software development in any programming language

Understanding of relational database concepts

Knowledge of data modelling and SQL

Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar

Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving abilities

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Understanding of Agile methodologies and collaborative development practices

Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team

Desirable
Exposure to web application development

Knowledge of cloud technologies or SaaS platforms

Experience with version control systems such as Git

Personal development projects, internships, or contributions to open-source projects

What We Offer
A genuine opportunity to launch your software development career

Mentoring from experienced software professionals

Exposure to the latest AI-powered development practices

A supportive and collaborative Agile culture

Career progression and ongoing professional development

The opportunity to work across the full software development lifecycle

A stable, growing Australian software company with a strong industry reputation

Ready to Apply?
If you're a bright and motivated developer looking for a unique opportunity to build your career, work with modern AI technologies, and make a meaningful contribution in a growing software company, we'd love to hear from you.
